fullDescription: Neon-grid retro-future startup landing page: near-black ink background lit by a cyan + magenta duotone, a synthwave perspective grid floor, scanlines and neon glow, Space Grotesk + JetBrains Mono type, a glowing wireframe canvas console hero, a 6-up feature grid, a node-stack canvas preview, a horizontal build roadmap, stat figures and a bold glowing CTA.

structured.summary: A neon-grid retro-futuristic startup landing page. Near-black ink background (#0a0c14) lit by an electric cyan (#22d3ee) + hot magenta (#e83e8c) duotone, a synthwave perspective grid floor, scanline texture and glowing neon UI. Space Grotesk display type with JetBrains Mono mono labels/chips. Top-down: sticky blurred nav, centered hero over a perspective wireframe grid with a glowing 'canvas console' mock and a floating prompt bar, a logo strip, a 6-up feature grid of glassy neon cards, a split canvas-preview section with a node-stack mock, a 4-node horizontal roadmap timeline, a proof band of stat figures + a pull-quote, a full-bleed glowing CTA over the grid, and a multi-column footer. Everything sits on a faint flat grid texture with cyan/magenta radial ambient glows.

style.description: Neon-grid retro-future / synthwave dev-tool aesthetic. Dark near-black ink base (#0a0c14, panel ink2 #0c0f1a) with a strict cyan + magenta duotone accent system, paper-white text (#eef2f8) and a muted slate (#8a93ab) for secondary copy. Hairline borders are translucent cyan (rgba(34,211,238,0.16)). Heavy use of glow: box-shadow rings + colored blur on buttons/cards/badges, neon text-shadow on accent headline words, radial ambient color glows, a perspective grid floor (synthwave horizon), a faint flat grid texture across the page, and a subtle CRT scanline overlay. Space Grotesk for all display/headings (700 tight tracking), JetBrains Mono for chips, eyebrows, code-ish labels and microcopy. Glassy cards with backdrop blur and gradient fills. Confident, high-energy, 'we ship fast' technical mood, never soft or pastel.
style.prompt: Design in a neon-grid retro-future (synthwave dev-tool) style. Palette: background ink #0a0c14, panel ink2 #0c0f1a, electric cyan #22d3ee (primary accent), hot magenta #e83e8c (secondary accent), paper text #eef2f8, muted slate #8a93ab, hairline borders rgba(34,211,238,0.16). Headings + UI use Space Grotesk (weights 400-700, tight -0.02em tracking); chips, eyebrows, microcopy, code labels and stat numbers use JetBrains Mono (400-600, uppercase, 0.12em letter-spacing). Build the retro-future read from: (1) a perspective grid floor — a cyan 46px line grid transformed with perspective(620px) rotateX(62deg) scale(1.8), masked top+bottom so it reads as a synthwave horizon; (2) a faint flat 52px cyan grid texture (rgba(34,211,238,0.05)) across whole sections; (3) a CRT scanline overlay (repeating 1px white-0.018 lines). Apply neon glow everywhere: glow-cyan = box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,211,238,0.4), 0 0 34px -6px rgba(34,211,238,0.55); glow-mag = same in magenta; text-glow on accent headline words (text-shadow 0 0 22px of the accent). Buttons: a primary cyan gradient pill (linear-gradient(180deg,#2ee6ff,#16b8d4), dark ink text #04121a, cyan glow ring) and a ghost button (transparent, hairline border, white/0.02 fill). Cards are glassy: linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,24,38,0.7),rgba(12,15,26,0.7)), 1px cyan-14% border, 16px radius, backdrop blur, lift + glow on hover. Chips are mono uppercase pills with a cyan hairline and faint cyan fill. Add large blurred radial ambient glows (cyan + magenta) behind the hero and CTA. Mood: dark, electric, high-energy, technical; cyan is the workhorse and magenta is the spark, used sparingly for one card / one roadmap node / the headline accent.

layout_and_structure.description: Single-column long-form dark landing page; content centered in a max-w-[1180px] container with px-6 gutters. Top-down order: fixed blurred sticky nav (64px), hero over the perspective grid with a glowing wireframe canvas console + floating prompt bar, a synthwave horizon line, a 'shipped by teams at' logo strip, a 6-up feature card grid, a split (2-col) canvas-preview section with a node-stack mock, a 4-node horizontal roadmap timeline, a proof section (4 stat figures + centered pull-quote), a full-bleed glowing CTA over the grid, and a 5-column footer with a status bottom-bar. Sections alternate flat-grid texture and bordered bands; radial glows and the perspective grid floor reappear on hero + CTA. Responsive: nav links hide below md, the 6-up features collapse 3->1, the preview/footer grids collapse to 1-2 cols, stats go 4->2, headline clamps scale down, and overflow-x is hidden so the grid/glows never cause horizontal scroll.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top header (z-50) with a translucent ink background (rgba(10,12,20,0.72)) and backdrop blur+saturate, plus a cyan-hairline bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1180px] row, height 64px: left = a small rounded logo badge (cyan-glow ring over an ink2 fill) holding a cyan ph:grid-nine icon, next to the 'Lumengrid' wordmark; center = mono-ish text links (Features, Canvas, Roadmap, Proof) in muted slate that brighten to paper on hover, hidden below md; right = a 'Log in' text link (hidden on mobile) and a cyan gradient pill CTA 'Start building'.

A centered hero over the perspective grid floor. Background layers: a faint flat cyan grid masked to fade downward, the synthwave perspective grid-floor, a scanline overlay, and two large blurred radial glows (cyan top-center, magenta upper-right). Content (max-w-[1180px], pt-[140px]): a mono cyan chip with a pulsing magenta dot ('New · v3 canvas engine is live'); a huge Space Grotesk 700 headline clamp(2.6rem,6.4vw,5.4rem) where the phrase 'before the demo' is cyan with a neon text-glow; a muted-slate sub-paragraph (max-w-[600px]); two CTAs (primary cyan gradient pill 'Generate my site' with arrow icon, ghost 'Watch the canvas build' with a cyan play icon); a mono microcopy line ('No credit card · 30 free generations · export to React + Tailwind'). Below, a glowing 'wireframe canvas console' mock (max-w-[920px]): a wire-card (near-black fill, cyan border, inset cyan glow + deep drop shadow) with a soft cyan->magenta blurred halo behind it; a top bar with three cyan/magenta/slate dots + 'canvas / orbital-labs.site' and a cyan 'building · 12 nodes' status; an inner flat-grid panel holding a 12-col mock layout (a HERO_BLOCK card with gradient bars + two mock buttons, then three small feature blocks one ringed in magenta glow); and a bottom 'prompt bar' with a magenta sparkle icon, a mono example prompt in quotes, and a pulsing cyan caret.

A thin bordered band (cyan-hairline top+bottom) under a 1px cyan->magenta gradient horizon line and a short downward cyan glow gradient. Inside max-w-[1180px], a centered row: a mono uppercase wide-tracked label 'Shipped by teams at' next to a wrapped row of 5 invented company wordmarks at ~70% opacity, each a cyan Phosphor icon (orbit, hexagon, circuitry, planet, cpu) + semibold name (Orbital, Hexnode, Voltic, Lunaire, Substrate).

A features section on the flat-grid texture. Header (max-w-[640px]): a mono '// the engine' chip, a Space Grotesk 700 heading where the second line ('renders at the speed of thought') is magenta with a magenta text-glow, and a muted intro paragraph. Below, a responsive grid (1 / md:3) of 6 glassy neon cards (card-hover: lift + cyan border + glow on hover). Each card: a rounded icon tile (cyan-glow ring over ink2, one card uses a magenta glow + magenta border accent) holding a Phosphor icon (cursor-click, swatches, code, users-three, plugs-connected, gauge), a ~18px semibold title, and a muted ~14px body line. Titles: Prompt to canvas, Neon-native theming, Clean code export, Multiplayer canvas, Agent-ready API, Ships fast scores green.

A full-bleed bordered section with its own perspective grid-floor (rotated, origin near top) + scanline. Inside max-w-[1180px], a 2-col grid (lg:2) aligned center. Left: a mono '// the canvas' chip, a Space Grotesk 700 heading ('See the whole launch on one infinite board'), a muted paragraph, and a 3-item check list (cyan ph:check-circle-fill icons) about branching nodes, locking the grid, and one-click code. Right: a glowing wire-card 'canvas' mock with a cyan->magenta blurred halo: a mono top bar ('orbital-labs.site · main' / cyan '100% · 1280px'), an inner flat-grid panel with three stacked node rows (each a rounded bordered row with a mono serial 01/02/03, mock content bars, a drag handle / a 3-up mini grid with one magenta-glow tile / a 'CTA' tag), and a footer row with a cyan gradient 'Export' button and a ghost 'Regenerate' button (magenta refresh icon).

A roadmap section on the flat-grid texture. Header row (md: space-between): a mono '// trajectory' chip + a Space Grotesk 700 'The build roadmap' heading on the left, a muted descriptive line on the right. Below, a horizontal timeline: on md+, a 2px cyan->blue->magenta gradient line runs behind the row at the dot height; a responsive grid (1 / md:4) of 4 nodes. Each node: a small status dot (filled cyan-glow for 'Shipped', pulsing magenta-glow for 'Building', hollow cyan-ring for 'Next') next to a mono uppercase status label, then a glassy card with a mono quarter tag (Q1-Q4 '26), a semibold title, and a muted line. The active ('Building') card gets a magenta-tinted border.

A bordered proof band (cyan-hairline top+bottom). Inside max-w-[1180px]: a divided stat row (2 cols mobile / 4 cols md, cyan-line dividers) of big JetBrains Mono figures with units — '8 min' (cyan + glow), '57k' (paper), '94%' (magenta + glow), '4.9' (paper) — each with a muted caption beneath. Then a centered pull-quote figure (max-w-[760px]): a short centered cyan->magenta gradient rule, a Space Grotesk 500 blockquote about pitching investors with a generated site, and a figcaption with a cyan-glow avatar chip (ph:user icon), an invented name (Priya Nandakumar) and a mono role ('founder, Orbital Labs').

A full-bleed closing CTA over the perspective grid-floor + scanline, with two large blurred radial glows (cyan center, magenta offset). Centered content (max-w-[760px]): a mono '// launch sequence' chip, a huge Space Grotesk 700 headline clamp(2.4rem,5.4vw,4.2rem) where 'generated tonight' is cyan with neon text-glow, a muted reassurance paragraph, two CTAs (primary cyan gradient pill 'Start building free' with a rocket icon, ghost 'Book a 15-min demo'), and a mono trust line ('Trusted by 12,000+ founders and indie hackers').

A footer on the flat-grid texture with a cyan-hairline top border. Inside max-w-[1180px], a 5-column grid: a wide brand column (the grid-nine logo badge + 'Lumengrid' wordmark, a short muted description, and three circular social icon buttons X / GitHub / Discord that turn cyan on hover) plus three link columns (Product, Build, Company) each with a mono uppercase cyan heading and muted links that brighten on hover. A top-bordered bottom bar (mono) splits the copyright ('© 2026 Lumengrid Labs · built on the grid') from Privacy / Terms links and a pulsing-cyan-dot 'all systems nominal' status.

special_ui_components.prompt: Perspective grid floor (synthwave horizon): a cyan 46px line grid with transform perspective(620px) rotateX(62deg) scale(1.8) and a top+bottom linear mask, reused on the hero, canvas-preview and CTA
Faint flat grid texture: a 52px cyan (rgba(34,211,238,0.05)) line grid layered across feature/roadmap/footer sections, and a tighter version inside the canvas mocks
CRT scanline overlay: a repeating 1px white-0.018 horizontal line pattern on the dark hero/preview/CTA sections
Neon glow system: glow-cyan / glow-mag box-shadow rings (1px colored border + colored blur), text-glow text-shadows on accent headline words, and large blurred radial ambient color glows

Glowing 'wireframe canvas console' mocks: near-black wire-cards (cyan border, inset cyan glow, deep drop shadow) with a cyan->magenta blurred halo, holding flat-grid panels of mock layout/node blocks and a floating prompt bar with a pulsing caret
Cyan gradient pill buttons (linear-gradient(180deg,#2ee6ff,#16b8d4), dark text, cyan glow ring) paired with hairline ghost buttons
Mono uppercase chips / eyebrows in JetBrains Mono with cyan hairline borders (e.g. '// the engine', '// the canvas', '// trajectory', '// launch sequence')
Horizontal roadmap timeline with a cyan->blue->magenta gradient connector line and shipped / building (pulsing) / next status dots

Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: grid-nine, arrow-right, play-circle, sparkle, cube, lightning, waveform, cursor-click, swatches, code, users-three, plugs-connected, gauge, check-circle, dots-six-vertical, export, arrows-clockwise, rocket-launch, user, social logos
JetBrains Mono stat figures with smaller muted units, divided by cyan vertical rules

structured.special_notes: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (400/500/600/700, display + UI) and JetBrains Mono (400/500/600, mono chips/labels/microcopy/stats). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette (ink #0a0c14, ink2 #0c0f1a, cyan #22d3ee, magenta #e83e8c, paper #eef2f8, mute #8a93ab, line rgba(34,211,238,0.16)). Iconify icons via the iconify-icon web component (ph:* / Phosphor set). body has overflow-x:hidden and html scroll-behavior:smooth so the perspective grid floor and large blurred glows never cause horizontal scroll. The mood must stay dark, electric and retro-future: cyan is the primary workhorse accent and magenta is used sparingly as the spark (one feature card, one roadmap node, headline/stat accents); never go soft, pastel or light-mode.
